gsheets.title: Google Sheets
gsheets.lead: Send a copy of the clinic's data to a Google spreadsheet — one tab per area, updated when you choose or once a day.
gsheets.connected: Google account connected. The spreadsheet is created at the first export.
gsheets.connected_as: Connected as {email}. The spreadsheet is created at the first export.
gsheets.reconnect_text: Google access was removed or expired. Connect the Google account again to continue exporting.
gsheets.oneway: One-way copy: DocBook → Google Sheets. Changes made in the spreadsheet never come back to DocBook, and each export rewrites the tabs.
gsheets.disconnect_hint: Disconnecting removes the stored access. The spreadsheet itself stays in Google Drive.
gsheets.disconnect_confirm: Stop exporting to Google Sheets and delete the stored access? The spreadsheet stays in Google Drive; you can delete it there yourself.
gsheets.disconnected: Google Sheets disconnected. Stored access was removed.
gsheets.ask_manager: Ask the clinic owner or manager to connect it in Settings → Google Sheets. You will then be able to export.
gsheets.choose_sub: Choose one of two ways. Both copy the same data.
gsheets.oauth_text: Sign in with Google and allow DocBook to create one spreadsheet in your Drive.
gsheets.oauth_p1: DocBook can only open the spreadsheet it creates — not the rest of your Drive.
gsheets.oauth_p2: You can remove the access at any time from your Google account.
gsheets.oauth_not_ready: This option needs the platform's Google set-up, which is not done yet. Use the Apps Script option, or ask the platform administrator.
gsheets.hook_title: With Apps Script (no Google Cloud set-up)
gsheets.hook_text: Paste a ready script into your own spreadsheet and give DocBook its web app address.
gsheets.hook_p1: Works with any Google account, in a spreadsheet you already have.
gsheets.hook_p2: A secret key in the script makes sure only DocBook can write to it.
gsheets.admin_note_text: The Google account option uses the OAuth client of Admin → Google sign-in. Add this address to that client's “Authorised redirect URIs” in Google Cloud:
gsheets.admin_note_api: also enable the Google Sheets API and the Google Drive API for the project.
gsheets.hook_step1: Open (or create) the Google spreadsheet that should receive the data, then choose Extensions → Apps Script.
gsheets.hook_step2: Delete what is in the editor, paste the script below and save.
gsheets.hook_step3: Click Deploy → New deployment → type “Web app”. Execute as: Me. Who has access: Anyone. Deploy and allow the access Google asks for.
gsheets.hook_step4: Copy the web app URL (it ends with /exec), paste it below and save. DocBook tests it straight away without sending clinic data.
gsheets.script_secret_note: The script contains this clinic's secret key. Do not share it. If it leaks, create a new key and paste the script again.
gsheets.rotate_hint: A new key stops the old script from receiving data until you paste the new one.
gsheets.rotate_confirm: Create a new secret key? Exports stop until you paste the new script into Apps Script and deploy it again.
gsheets.secret_rotated: A new secret key was created. Paste the new script into Apps Script and deploy it again.
gsheets.webhook_started: Follow the steps below to finish the set-up.
gsheets.saved_test_failed: Saved, but the connection test failed:
gsheets.options_sub: Clinic data only. Each area gets its own tab with a header row.

tab_text.summary: Revenue, expenses, salaries and net result per month.
tab_text.appointments: Date, time, doctor, service, type, status, channel and payment. Patient names only when patients are included.
tab_text.patients: Name, phone, e-mail, sex, date of birth, insurer and file number. Never clinical notes, allergies, conditions or ID numbers.
tab_text.invoices: Invoice number, date, doctor, service, discount, amount, payment method and insurer.
tab_text.expenses: Date, category, description, amount and payment method.
tab_text.doctor_payroll: Payments to doctors per month: salary, commission, bonuses, deductions and net pay.
tab_text.staff_salaries: Salary payments to other staff (when the staff payroll is in use).
tab_text.supplies: Items, supplier, stock, reorder level and stock value.

gsheets.patients_warn_text: Patient names and contact details will be copied to Google, outside DocBook's protection and access log. The clinic is responsible for who can open the spreadsheet and for complying with patient-privacy rules.
gsheets.patients_ack: I understand, and I accept responsibility on behalf of the clinic.
gsheets.period_help: Appointments, invoices, expenses and payroll from this period. Stock is always current.
gsheets.note_oneway: One-way only: edits in the spreadsheet are overwritten at the next export and never come back to DocBook.
gsheets.note_never: Never exported: visit notes, diagnoses, prescriptions, vital signs, allergies, chronic conditions, national and insurance numbers, and the clinic's settings.
gsheets.note_rewrite: Every export rewrites the chosen tabs completely. Up to 50,000 rows per tab.
gsheets.log_empty_text: Exports appear here with their result.

media_lib.title: Media library
media_lib.lead: Images and PDF files of the clinic, uploaded once and reused on the clinic page.
media_lib.empty_text: Upload the clinic's photos (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF) and PDF files, up to 5 MB each.
media_lib.name: Name
media_lib.files_help: PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or PDF — up to 5 MB each, 10 at a time. SVG is not accepted.
media_lib.alt_help: A short description read by screen readers and shown when an image cannot load.
media_lib.make_public: Public — may be shown on the clinic page
media_lib.delete_confirm: Delete this file? This cannot be undone.
media_lib.delete_used_confirm: This file is used in {n} place(s) (for example the clinic page). Deleting it removes it from there too. Delete anyway?
media_lib.rules: Files are checked by their content: only PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF and PDF are accepted, up to 5 MB each. Links to files work only for signed-in members of the clinic.
media_lib.rules_public: Public images can appear on the clinic page for everyone. Images chosen for the clinic page become public automatically.
media_lib.picker_sub: From the clinic's media library, or upload a new one.
media_lib.picker_empty: No images here yet. Upload one.
media_lib.picker_error: Could not load the library. Try again.
media_lib.page_sub: A cover image and a small gallery on the clinic's public page.
media_lib.gallery_help: Up to 12 images, shown in this order.
media_lib.page_public_note: Images shown on the clinic page are public: anyone who opens the page can see them. Never use photos of patients or documents.
media_lib.needs_js: Choosing images needs JavaScript. You can still manage files in the
media_lib.doctor_photo_sub: Shown on the clinic page, the booking page and staff screens.
media_lib.doctor_photo_help: Choose a square photo from the media library (or upload one there). The photo becomes public because the clinic page shows it.
media_lib.doctor_photo_manager_only: Only a clinic manager can choose the photo (it comes from the media library).

errors_integrations.SECRETS_KEY: The server has no encryption key to store credentials. Ask the platform administrator to set APP_KEY.
errors_integrations.GSHEETS_NOT_CONNECTED: Google Sheets is not connected yet.
errors_integrations.GSHEETS_RUNNING: An export is already running. Wait a moment and refresh.
errors_integrations.GSHEETS_NO_CLIENT: The platform's Google set-up is not complete.
errors_integrations.GSHEETS_STATE: This link has expired or was opened in another browser. Please start again.
errors_integrations.GSHEETS_CANCELLED: Access was not granted in Google.
errors_integrations.GSHEETS_SCOPE: Allow DocBook to create its spreadsheet in your Google Drive, then try again.
errors_integrations.GSHEETS_NO_REFRESH: Google did not give lasting access. Remove DocBook from your Google account's third-party access, then connect again.
errors_integrations.GSHEETS_RECONNECT: Google access was removed or expired. Connect the Google account again.
errors_integrations.GSHEETS_NO_SECRET: Start the Apps Script set-up first.
errors_integrations.GSHEETS_WEBHOOK_BLOCKED: This address cannot be reached from the server.
errors_integrations.GSHEETS_WEBHOOK_NETWORK: Could not reach the web app
errors_integrations.GSHEETS_WEBHOOK_SECRET: The web app refused the secret key. Paste the latest script and deploy it again.
errors_integrations.GSHEETS_WEBHOOK_ACCESS: The web app asks for a Google sign-in. Deploy it with “Who has access: Anyone”.
errors_integrations.GSHEETS_WEBHOOK_FAILED: The web app did not accept the data
errors_integrations.MEDIA_TOO_BIG: The file is larger than 5 MB.
errors_integrations.MEDIA_TOO_MANY: Upload up to 10 files at a time.
errors_integrations.MEDIA_TYPE: Upload PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or PDF files only.
errors_integrations.MEDIA_SVG: SVG files are not accepted for security reasons. Save the image as PNG or WebP.
errors_integrations.MEDIA_QUOTA: Your clinic's media storage is full. Delete files you no longer use, or get more space by upgrading the package.
errors_integrations.MEDIA_IN_USE: This file is in use. Confirm to delete it anyway.
errors_integrations.MEDIA_PUBLIC_IN_USE: This image is shown on the clinic page. Remove it there before making it private.
errors_integrations.MEDIA_NOT_IMAGE: Choose images from the media library.
